# Brick Instructions For You

Brick Instructions For You is a LEGO instruction video website connected to the LEGO Instructions For You YouTube channel.

The site contains LEGO set instruction pages for 2025 and 2026, organised by set number, theme and year.

Important URLs:
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/2025/
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/2026/
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/themes/
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/search/
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/sitemap.xml

LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group, which does not sponsor, authorise or endorse this website.
